description: SL-OO: shifts each of Solim's results an octave up or down after everything else, and can either replace the original value or add the shifted one beside it; it goes to the right of the Solim module

params.text: Shifts that result an octave up or down, or leaves it alone, with the middle position taking no action
Replaces the original result with the shifted one when it is lit; unlit, the original stays and the shifted value is added to the sequence
Re-orders the finished sequence into the sort order set on the Solim module; with sorting switched off there, it changes nothing

inputs.text: Replaces that row's shift switch while it is patched: a positive voltage shifts up, a negative one shifts down, and 0V takes no action
Replaces that row's replace button while it is patched: a positive voltage replaces the original, 0V or below keeps it and adds the shifted value

notes: this expander is placed to the right of the Solim module; only one is allowed in a chain, and the lamp at the top turns green when it is connected
the rows work on the results of everything before them, including limiting, sorting and any randomising
values added here are placed around the originals in the Solim sort order, and once eight values are reached the rest are dropped
values this module adds or removes are not themselves processed by the row they land in
menu: Sort only connected ports — re-orders the values of ports with a cable and leaves the values on unconnected ports where they are
